title.narrative: Contribution to Global Partnership for Education - GPE - 2023-2026

description.narrative: The objective is to support GPE achieve the key results as identified in GPE's 2025 Strategy, i.e. to accelerate access, learning outcomes and gender equality through equitable, inclusive and resilient education systems fit for the 21st century. In line with the MFA Organisation Strategy for GPE 2023-2026, the focus is on GPE's contributions in the area of promoting gender equality in and through education, HDP-nexus approach to education, and the education-climate change nexus. Reference: https://www.globalpartnership.org/results/gpe-impact

The partner, Global Partnership for Education (GPE), does not provide a standardised Results Framework including outputs. Hence reporting against results will derive from the partner's own annual reporting against its Strategic Plan Results Framework. Reference: https://www.globalpartnership.org/results/gpe-impact
